current.text: The Warriors' projected starters are Curry, Podziemski, Lendeborg, Green and Horford. Santos is projected to come off the bench.
He competes with Yaxel Lendeborg for the same starting job. Podziemski and Melton are also in the mix on the wing.
He might still start, and rest days for Golden State's veterans should give him enough minutes. Josh still prefers Podziemski and Lendeborg.
The more Draymond Green plays center, the more minutes open up for Santos and Lendeborg.
Draft him as a late flyer in rounds 11 to 13. He could be a top 70 player after the trade deadline, and with Porzingis out his usage could go above 20 percent.
Pair him with Lendeborg as a hedge and keep whichever of the two wins the role.
After the trade deadline last season he played 31 minutes a game and ranked 72nd, with 15 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists and 1.5 steals per game.
Some of his shooting last season was fluky and may not hold.
Jimmy Butler is out for at least half the season.
Butler's return should shake up the wing rotation again and can cut into Santos's role.
Golden State is reportedly treating this as a gap year. The team is worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans.
Golden State's depth is very poor, so minutes should go up across the rotation. Steve Kerr's rotations are hard to predict, with a lot of mixing on the wing.
Golden State's schedule is good for playoffs that end March 28. It has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.

durable.text: He can create his own shot and has size. Outside of Curry, almost nobody else on the Warriors can create for himself.
He scores much more when Curry is out than when he plays next to him.

note: He sits right at the edge of our 144-player pool. Yahoo ranks him 141 and ESPN 248, and both value him at 0 USD, so take him for 1 USD as a last-round flyer and draft Lendeborg as a hedge. He has no category outlier and his scoring is weak at 7.4 projected points, so his value rests on the role. In the first weeks, check who starts, whether he plays 25 minutes or more, and how many shots he gets with Porzingis and Butler out. Drop him quickly if Lendeborg and Podziemski take the minutes.
